chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Ibn Mahbub, from Hammad, from Ziyad, from Sulayman, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام: concerning
a man who said to his wife, after he had consummated the marriage with her, "I did not find you a virgin." He عليه السلام said: "There is no hadd punishment upon him."

key_terms.رَجُلٍ: a man; the legal subject in the case
key_terms.لِٱمْرَأَتِهِ: to his wife; indicating the marital context

ai.seo_question: Is a husband subject to hadd punishment if he tells his wife after consummation that he did not find her a virgin?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a husband who tells his wife after consummation that he did not find her to be a virgin. Imam Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام states that no hadd punishment applies to him in this case, indicating a specific fiqhi limit concerning accusations within marriage.
